preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.
The diameter of the tree is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.
The degree of each vertex in the tree is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if a tree satisfying the conditions exists, or 'NO' if it does not.
If the output is 'YES', then there are exactly n - 1 lines describing the edges of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u, v <= n for u, v in edges) and all(u != v for u, v in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices in the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= deg(u) <= k for u in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Each vertex in the tree has a degree of at most k.
The diameter of the constructed tree is exactly d.
